title: Aklato
extract:
The Aklato is a dual wield version of the  Lato, which features a higher fire rate and magazine size, but lower accuracy and reload speed.
It can be sold for  5,000.

Characteristics
This weapon deals primarily  Slash damage.
Advantages over other Secondary   weapons (excluding modular weapons):

Low recoil.
Normal Attack (wiki attack index 1)
Above average magazine size (30)
Very high ammo pickup (40)
High ammo max (210)
Above average fire rate (5.00 attacks/sec)
Very high disposition (●●●●● (1.52x))
Disadvantages over other Secondary   weapons (excluding modular weapons):

Poor accuracy at mid-long range.
Normal Attack (wiki attack index 1)
Low crit chance (10.00%)
Low burst DPS (216)
Low sustained DPS (154.28)
Below average damage per shot (43.2)
Below average total damage (40)
Low accuracy (4.00° to 14.00°)
Very low reload speed (2.40 s)
Very low status chance (6.00%)
Low crit multiplier (1.80x)
See WARFRAME Wiki:Stat Comparison/Percentiles for more details.

Comparisons:

 Aklato (Normal Attack), compared to  Lato (Normal Attack):
Equal base damage
Lower  Impact damage ( 6 vs.  10)
Higher  Slash damage ( 24 vs.  20)
Higher burst DPS (216 vs. 194.4)
Higher sustained DPS (154.28 vs. 149.53)
Higher fire rate (5.00 attacks/sec vs. 4.50 attacks/sec)
Larger magazine (30 vs. 15)
Slower reload time (2.40 s vs. 1.00 s)
Less accurate (11.1 vs. 18.2)
Wider first-shot spread (4.00° vs. 0.50°)
Wider maximum spread (14.00° vs. 10.50°)
Higher Mastery Rank required (3 vs. 0)
Higher disposition (●●●●● (1.52x) vs. ●●●●● (1.40x))

Acquisition
A built Aklato can be purchased from the Market for  25,000.

Trivia
Previously, Aklato used the same icon and in-game model as  Akbolto. It was changed several patches later.
It can be noted that for some users Aklato appears to land shots near the top of the reticle.
As with other dual pistols, wielding the Aklato while holding a Corpus datamass will result in the Warframe wielding a single pistol, but with retained magazine size and reload time.
Players who purchased platinum through Rixty also received a free Aklato, along with a unique, Rixty-only skin with a free Orokin Catalyst installed.
The name is likely derived from "akimbo" and "Lato."
In the eight minute Dark Sector trailer, in which the game was much more like Warframe than the final product was, an Excalibur-wearing Hayden Tenno used the Aklato pistols.
